Canonical and Historical Context

1 Chronicles belongs to the Catholic Old Testament and is grouped among the Historical Books. That canonical placement is a fact about the received Catholic Bible, while proposals about composition, date, sources, and historical reconstruction are scholarly judgments of differing probability. The themes named by the approved curriculum are genealogy, David, worship, priesthood, and temple preparation. A responsible context lesson keeps those categories apart and checks precise historical claims against book-specific scholarship before approval.
